messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — we need a decision on model admissions. Customer requests (search rerank, summarization) are growing but catalog churn is causing stability issues for downstream routes. Proposing we use RICE + an explicit "stability cost" multiplier. Thoughts?
Maya: +1. Also add "operational surface" under Effort. New model -> more monitoring, evals, fallback rules. :thinking:
Alex: I sketched a tiny scoring sheet:
```
Model | Reach | Impact | Confidence | Effort | StabilityCost | RICE_score
mistral-xl | 8 | 7 | 0.6 | 3 | 2 | calc...
open-ib-7b | 6 | 4 | 0.7 | 1 | 1 | calc...
```
We can normalize StabilityCost 1-3. Want to avoid re-onboarding every 2w.
Samir: Caveat: quantization/kv-cache differences cause subtle latency spikes. StabilityCost should include "latency regressions" and "failure modes".
Olivia: Practical sequencing: 1) customer-critical high RICE + low stability cost, 2) medium RICE w/ canary on Dedicated, 3) experimental models in a "rotation" lane with shorter TTL. That reduces churn impact on Console dashboards.
Jordan: OK. Can Product commit to a top-3 list by EOD Friday? We need target dates for rollout + canary plan. @Olivia can you own canary runbook?
Olivia: I can. Will add a canary checklist and target metrics (p99, error-rate, token-cost delta) in the runbook. :white_check_mark: 
deploy-bot: Rollout checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-canary v1.2
Alex: Also propose we adopt a lightweight "catalog-hold" flag for 2w when a model lands to avoid immediate rotations.
Maya: Love that. Minimizes churn while we gather signals.
Jordan: Great. I'll collate scores into a tiny spreadsheet and ping infra for canary capacity. Thanks team :raised_hands:
